entries.text: Save and reuse your favorite dividend calculator setups, with a one-click option to fill it in from your holdings
Added a Contact page so you can reach us directly
Added Roadmap, Glossary, Help Center, About, Disclosures, and Security pages, plus fixed up footer links
Automatic brokerage account syncing is now a Pro feature; manually adding holdings or importing from CSV stays free for everyone
Fixed pre-market price changes sometimes showing as stuck at 0%
Fixed the app navigation showing up incorrectly on the Privacy and Changelog pages
Added a public changelog so you can see what's new
Added the BullPen logo throughout the app and as your browser tab icon
The AI assistant can now look up any company's Financial Health score and profile, even ones not yet in our database
Fixed financial health scores occasionally showing incorrect or missing data during high-traffic periods
